subject: docs/coop/artifacts/coordinator-decisions.D-228.draft.md
discipline: Independent. Refute, do not confirm. No claim in the draft was accepted on the draft's own account of itself. Every cited digest was recomputed with shasum -a 256 against live bytes and compared literally, in both directions where a second source existed (v4's own file08Pin, head and requiredNowUnchanged were read from v4 and matched against live file 08, live HEAD and live condition row 4, rather than against the draft's summary of them). Every live-register claim was re-derived from file 08's own bytes: the DR-G28 status token, the DR-131 status token, the last gate row, the condition-2 and condition-4 cells, and condition 5's structural position. g28-leftover-join.v3's obligation array was enumerated object by object and each leftoverDesign boolean read directly instead of trusting the draft's one-line summary, then cross-checked against the join's own summary.leftoverDesign array. Frozen v3's four asserted values were read from v3's own bytes to test whether the draft's historical framing was earned. Both Stage A JSONs were parsed and their advisories and observations arrays enumerated and counted, with identifier greps run over both files to test for minted or missing identifiers in each direction. The D-167-through-D-227 non-unwrite span was extracted mechanically and set-differenced against range(167,228) rather than read by eye. The D-227 COORD entry was read in full and diffed against this draft to test whether each lineage token incremented correctly rather than merely looking plausible. Every occurrence of SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, Class A, Class B, D9, D-056, and implementation was enumerated with surrounding context rather than counted. The Codex counterpart review of THIS draft was not opened.
decisionRule: CONSENT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX.

Decision 2 enumerates HARNESS-SPEC, NAMED-CORPUS and INPUT-CORPUS as measured closed and FX-AUTHORING as remaining, which is four of the join's six obligations. OBL-G28-EXECUTION and OBL-NT78-UNNAMED-REMAINDER-CLOSED are not enumerated by name. This is not an omission defect: both carry leftoverDesign false, the draft makes no exhaustiveness claim over the roster, EXECUTION is covered in substance by 'Remainder is G28 execution once fixture implementations exist', and NT78 closure is covered by the non-reopening sentence. D-227 states the G27 equivalent in the identical four-item shape. No finding.

v4 carries two keys that read as contradictory on their names, file08DoesNotCarryG28 and file08CarriesG28. I resolved them against the bytes: they are false and true respectively, i.e. a consistent double-negation pin, both agreeing that file 08 carries G28. Live file 08 line 364 confirms the D-154 naming. The draft's 'File 08 carries G28 (D-154)' (line 82) is correct. In any case v4 is frozen, already dual-ACCEPTed, and is not this subject. No finding.

The spelling 'remasurement' recurs in the title and at lines 30 and 108, while line 71 uses 'remeasurement'. I declined this as a finding: 'remasurement' is the established term of art in this register, carried in the D-203 and D-227 COORD headings and in the dispatch prompt's own wording, so the draft is consistent with house usage rather than introducing an error.

Claude Stage A advisory CLAUDE-G28-V4-A1 observes that g28-input-corpus.v1 is absent from v4's remeasurement-clause roster, and A2 that basedOn.d078 is unpinned. Both are non-blocking properties of v4, which is frozen and already dual-ACCEPTed 0/0. Neither bears on whether THIS draft records v4 accurately, and the draft correctly preserves both identifiers rather than resolving or suppressing them. Not a finding against the draft.
